stage: Third development stage, before untouched evaluation
rms_selection: The original rule selects 0.02 seconds among RMS candidates, but development detection is only 28-33% and average localized repeat recognition 19.9%; zero false attention is insufficient evidence of retained foreground sensitivity.
new_candidate: Normalize STFT power by a smoothed median of mel-band energies relative to a spectral template fitted only during the existing three unlabelled warmup clips. Fixed 0.02 s gain time; unchanged gate, features after power normalization, matching and confirmation rules.
reason: An all-power RMS tracker can follow the foreground's own energy. A median across bands should reduce influence of localized events; this is a hypothesis tested with broad and long positives too, not an oracle assumption.
evaluation: Compare all six earlier RMS times, the fixed spectral-gain candidate and three unchanged baselines on seeds 1200-1209. No retuning afterward. Candidate is not accepted merely for rejecting backgrounds; report stationary foreground losses and correct localized identity in all modulation cells.
limitations: Warmup profile freezes afterward; spectral background shifts and foreground contamination during calibration are separate generalization tests. This is not PCEN or a recorded-audio result.
